name: Dual-band regime gate (mid macro AND moderate VIX, both between) arms RSI-oversold reversion
rationale: THESIS: the cleanest expression of the niche — BOTH regime gauges expressed as BANDS (macro_regime between a mid range, vix_level between a moderate range), arming an RSI-oversold reversion. The bet: reversion edge is jointly non-monotonic — it needs macro neither euphoric nor broken AND vol neither dead-calm nor panicked. Two two-sided gates is the structural novelty vs every gt/lt sibling. DISCONFIRMER 1 (are the bands real or disguised one-sided cuts?): four one-sided siblings (macro gt-only, macro lt-only, vix gt-only, vix lt-only) bracket this; if any one-sided cut matches the dual band, the bands are relabelled thresholds. DISCONFIRMER 2 (just buy-the-dip?): ungated RSI baseline. DISCONFIRMER 3 (do you need BOTH bands?): single-band siblings (macro-band-only, vix-band-only). DISCONFIRMER 4 (holdout): with two-sided gates the search space is larger so overfit risk is higher — the frozen-param recent slice staying positive is the binding test.
catalyst: macro_regime and vix_level BOTH inside their fitted moderate bands with RSI oversold
